## Checklist
- [ ] Acceptance criteria for the Task are met with **real** behaviour (no fake UI)
- [ ] Tests added or updated
- [ ] CI is green (or will be after merge of required base)
- [ ] No unbounded local full builds used to “verify” on a constrained machine
- [ ] No proprietary source, assets, or RE material introduced
- [ ] Public research notes are original summaries + URLs only (if applicable)
- [ ] ROADMAP / CHANGELOG / parity updated if this completes a tracked item
- [ ] Secrets and tokens not committed
- [ ] User-facing strings and UI are original (no copied trade dress)
- [ ] No heavy build was run locally — the CI result is the verification
- [ ] New dependencies are within the allowed licence classes (MIT/Apache-2.0) and recorded in `ATTRIBUTION.md`

### Accessibility (UI changes)

Complete this subsection for any change that touches the interface. If the
change does not touch the UI, tick "Not applicable" and skip the rest.

- [ ] Not applicable (no UI change)
- [ ] The keyboard path works end to end
- [ ] Focus is visible and follows a logical order
- [ ] Form fields are labelled and errors are announced, not just coloured
- [ ] Colour is not the only signal for state
- [ ] Reduced motion is respected (animations minimised or disabled)
- [ ] A screen-reader spot-check was done (see `ACCESSIBILITY.md` for what is
      and is not covered)
